description: Reviewed 70-task corpus for the local 71-table 'Northwind Corp' benchmark database (scripts/bench/*.sql). Data ends 2026-10-10 UTC: 'yesterday' = 2026-10-10, 'last quarter' = 2026-Q3. needed_relations are schema-qualified. Ground-truth SQL is bounded, uses fixed dates, and was verified as bench_owner. Convention: money is summed in the native amount column unless the question asks for USD.

tasks.name: st_regions
tasks.question: List all regions

queries.name: st_regions
queries.sql: select region_id, region_code, region_name, hq_city from public.regions order by region_id

tasks.name: st_carriers
tasks.question: List all shipping carriers

queries.name: st_carriers
queries.sql: select carrier_id, carrier_name, scac, is_active from ops.carriers order by carrier_id

tasks.name: st_warehouses
tasks.question: Show all warehouses and whether they are run by a third party (3PL)

queries.name: st_warehouses
queries.sql: select warehouse_code, warehouse_name, city, is_3pl from inventory.warehouses order by warehouse_code

tasks.name: st_plans
tasks.question: List all subscription plans with their monthly price

queries.name: st_plans
queries.sql: select plan_code, plan_name, tier, monthly_price, is_legacy from finance.plans order by monthly_price, plan_code

tasks.name: st_kb_articles
tasks.question: Show the 20 most viewed knowledge base articles

queries.name: st_kb_articles
queries.sql: select article_id, title, view_count from support.kb_articles order by view_count desc, article_id limit 20

tasks.name: st_promo_codes
tasks.question: Which promo codes give the biggest discount?

queries.name: st_promo_codes
queries.sql: select promo_code, discount_pct from sales.promo_codes order by discount_pct desc, promo_code limit 20

tasks.name: st_currencies
tasks.question: List all currencies

queries.name: st_currencies
queries.sql: select currency_code, currency_name, symbol, minor_units from public.currencies order by currency_code

tasks.name: syn_clients_region
tasks.question: How many clients do we have in each region?

queries.name: syn_clients_region
queries.sql: select r.region_code, count(*) as clients from crm.accounts a join public.regions r on r.region_id = a.region_id group by r.region_code order by clients desc

tasks.name: syn_staff_per_dept
tasks.question: How many staff are in each department?

queries.name: syn_staff_per_dept
queries.sql: select d.dept_name, count(*) as staff from hr.employees e join hr.departments d on d.department_id = e.department_id where e.term_dt is null group by d.dept_name order by staff desc, d.dept_name

tasks.name: syn_sku_lookup
tasks.question: Find the item with SKU SKU-000123 and its list price

queries.name: syn_sku_lookup
queries.sql: select product_id, sku, product_name, list_price from inventory.products where sku = 'SKU-000123'

tasks.name: syn_qty_sold
tasks.question: Which SKUs have the highest total qty ordered?

queries.name: syn_qty_sold
queries.sql: select p.sku, sum(oi.qty) as total_qty from sales.order_items oi join inventory.products p on p.product_id = oi.product_id group by p.sku order by total_qty desc, p.sku limit 20

tasks.name: syn_item_code
tasks.question: Which product does the external item code MKT-0024087 refer to?

queries.name: syn_item_code
queries.sql: select ia.item_code, ia.external_system, p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name from inventory.item_aliases ia join inventory.products p on p.product_id = ia.product_id where ia.item_code = 'MKT-0024087'

tasks.name: syn_opp_amt
tasks.question: What is the total opp amt by stage?

queries.name: syn_opp_amt
queries.sql: select stage, sum(amt) as total_amt, count(*) as opps from crm.opportunities group by stage order by total_amt desc

tasks.name: syn_headcount_country
tasks.question: What is our current headcount by country?

queries.name: syn_headcount_country
queries.sql: select location_country, count(*) as headcount from hr.employees where term_dt is null group by location_country order by headcount desc, location_country

tasks.name: j2_tickets_by_tier
tasks.question: Average ticket resolution time in hours by support tier

queries.name: j2_tickets_by_tier
queries.sql: select t.tier_name, round(avg(extract(epoch from (tk.resolved_at - tk.opened_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 1) as avg_hours from support.tickets tk join support.tiers t on t.tier_id = tk.tier_id where tk.resolved_at is not null group by t.tier_name order by avg_hours

tasks.name: j2_shipments_per_carrier
tasks.question: How many shipments has each carrier handled?

queries.name: j2_shipments_per_carrier
queries.sql: select c.carrier_name, count(*) as shipments from ops.shipments s join ops.carriers c on c.carrier_id = s.carrier_id group by c.carrier_name order by shipments desc, c.carrier_name

tasks.name: j2_mrr_by_plan
tasks.question: Total MRR of active subscriptions by plan

queries.name: j2_mrr_by_plan
queries.sql: select p.plan_code, p.plan_name, count(*) as active_subscriptions, sum(s.mrr_amt) as mrr_usd from finance.subscriptions s join finance.plans p on p.plan_id = s.plan_id where s.status in ('active', 'past_due') group by p.plan_code, p.plan_name order by mrr_usd desc

tasks.name: j2_contacts_per_account
tasks.question: Which 10 accounts have the most contacts?

queries.name: j2_contacts_per_account
queries.sql: select a.account_id, a.account_name, count(*) as contacts from crm.contacts c join crm.accounts a on a.account_id = c.account_id group by a.account_id, a.account_name order by contacts desc, a.account_id limit 10

tasks.name: j2_campaign_leads
tasks.question: Leads per marketing campaign and how many of them converted

queries.name: j2_campaign_leads
queries.sql: select c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, count(l.lead_id) as leads, count(l.converted_account_id) as converted from marketing.campaigns c join crm.leads l on l.campaign_id = c.campaign_id group by c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name order by leads desc, c.campaign_id limit 50

tasks.name: j2_dept_cost_centers
tasks.question: Which cost centers belong to each department?

queries.name: j2_dept_cost_centers
queries.sql: select d.dept_name, cc.cc_code, cc.cc_name from finance.cost_centers cc join hr.departments d on d.department_id = cc.department_id order by d.dept_name, cc.cc_code

tasks.name: j2_supplier_products
tasks.question: Which suppliers supply the most products?

queries.name: j2_supplier_products
queries.sql: select s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, count(*) as products from inventory.product_suppliers ps join inventory.suppliers s on s.supplier_id = ps.supplier_id group by s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name order by products desc, s.supplier_id limit 20

tasks.name: mh_invoice_region
tasks.question: Total invoiced amount by sales region for invoices issued in 2026-Q3

queries.name: mh_invoice_region
queries.sql: select r.region_code, sum(i.total_amt) as invoiced from finance.invoices i join sales.customers c on c.cust_id = i.cust_id join crm.accounts a on a.account_id = c.account_id join public.regions r on r.region_id = a.region_id where i.issued_dt >= '2026-07-01' and i.issued_dt < '2026-10-01' group by r.region_code order by invoiced desc

tasks.name: mh_invoice_units_category
tasks.question: Units invoiced per top-level product category for invoices issued in September 2026

queries.name: mh_invoice_units_category
queries.sql: select tc.category_name, sum(il.qty) as units from finance.invoice_lines il join finance.invoices i on i.invoice_id = il.invoice_id join sales.order_items oi on oi.order_item_id = il.order_item_id join inventory.products p on p.product_id = oi.product_id join inventory.product_categories c on c.category_id = p.category_id join inventory.product_categories tc on tc.category_id = coalesce(c.parent_id, c.category_id) where i.issued_dt >= '2026-09-01' and i.issued_dt < '2026-10-01' group by tc.category_name order by units desc

tasks.name: mh_return_rate_category
tasks.question: Return rate by top-level product category

queries.name: mh_return_rate_category
queries.sql: select tc.category_name, count(r.return_id) as returns, count(*) as items, round(count(r.return_id)::numeric / count(*), 4) as return_rate from sales.order_items oi join inventory.products p on p.product_id = oi.product_id join inventory.product_categories c on c.category_id = p.category_id join inventory.product_categories tc on tc.category_id = coalesce(c.parent_id, c.category_id) left join sales.returns r on r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id group by tc.category_name order by return_rate desc

tasks.name: mh_tickets_agent_department
tasks.question: How many support tickets were handled by agents from each HR department?

queries.name: mh_tickets_agent_department
queries.sql: select d.dept_name, count(*) as tickets from support.tickets t join support.agents a on a.agent_id = t.assigned_agent_id join hr.employees e on e.employee_id = a.employee_id join hr.departments d on d.department_id = e.department_id group by d.dept_name order by tickets desc, d.dept_name

tasks.name: mh_api_failures_region
tasks.question: Failed API requests on 2026-10-10 broken down by the customer account's region

queries.name: mh_api_failures_region
queries.sql: select r.region_code, count(*) as failed from ops.api_request_log l join ops.api_keys k on k.api_key_id = l.api_key_id join crm.accounts a on a.account_id = k.account_id join public.regions r on r.region_id = a.region_id where l.status_code >= 400 and l.requested_at >= '2026-10-10' and l.requested_at < '2026-10-11' group by r.region_code order by failed desc

tasks.name: mh_payments_tier
tasks.question: Total settled payments received in September 2026 per account tier

queries.name: mh_payments_tier
queries.sql: select a.tier, sum(p.amt) as paid from finance.payments p join finance.invoices i on i.invoice_id = p.invoice_id join sales.customers c on c.cust_id = i.cust_id join crm.accounts a on a.account_id = c.account_id where p.status = 'settled' and p.paid_dt >= '2026-09-01' and p.paid_dt < '2026-10-01' group by a.tier order by paid desc

tasks.name: mh_campaign_order_revenue
tasks.question: Which marketing campaigns generated the most order revenue in USD through their leads, opportunities and quotes?

queries.name: mh_campaign_order_revenue
queries.sql: select c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, sum(o.total_usd) as revenue_usd from sales.orders o join sales.quotes q on q.quote_id = o.quote_id join crm.opportunities op on op.opp_id = q.opp_id join crm.leads l on l.lead_id = op.lead_id join marketing.campaigns c on c.campaign_id = l.campaign_id group by c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name order by revenue_usd desc, c.campaign_id limit 10

tasks.name: agg_monthly_orders
tasks.question: Monthly order count and USD revenue for 2025

queries.name: agg_monthly_orders
queries.sql: select date_trunc('month', order_dt) as month, count(*) as orders, sum(total_usd) as revenue_usd from sales.orders where order_dt >= '2025-01-01' and order_dt < '2026-01-01' group by 1 order by 1

tasks.name: agg_top_customers_q3_emea
tasks.question: Top 10 customers by revenue in USD in 2026-Q3 in the EMEA region

queries.name: agg_top_customers_q3_emea
queries.sql: select c.cust_id, c.customer_name, sum(o.total_usd) as revenue_usd from sales.orders o join sales.customers c on c.cust_id = o.cust_id join crm.accounts a on a.account_id = c.account_id join public.regions r on r.region_id = a.region_id where r.region_code = 'EMEA' and o.order_dt >= '2026-07-01' and o.order_dt < '2026-10-01' and o.status not in ('cancelled', 'draft') group by c.cust_id, c.customer_name order by revenue_usd desc, c.cust_id limit 10

tasks.name: agg_failed_api_yesterday
tasks.question: How many API requests failed yesterday?

queries.name: agg_failed_api_yesterday
queries.sql: select count(*) as failed_requests from ops.api_request_log where status_code >= 400 and requested_at >= '2026-10-10' and requested_at < '2026-10-11'

tasks.name: agg_pageviews_daily
tasks.question: Page views per day in September 2026

queries.name: agg_pageviews_daily
queries.sql: select viewed_at::date as day, count(*) as views from analytics.page_views where viewed_at >= '2026-09-01' and viewed_at < '2026-10-01' group by 1 order by 1

tasks.name: agg_gl_q2
tasks.question: GL expense by cost center versus budget for 2026-Q2

queries.name: agg_gl_q2
queries.sql: with actual as (select g.cost_center_id, sum(g.debit_amt - g.credit_amt) as actual from finance.gl_entries g join finance.chart_of_accounts ca on ca.gl_account_id = g.gl_account_id where ca.account_type = 'expense' and g.entry_dt >= '2026-04-01' and g.entry_dt < '2026-07-01' group by g.cost_center_id), budget as (select b.cost_center_id, sum(b.budget_amt) as budget from finance.budgets b join finance.chart_of_accounts ca on ca.gl_account_id = b.gl_account_id where ca.account_type = 'expense' and b.fiscal_month >= '2026-04-01' and b.fiscal_month < '2026-07-01' group by b.cost_center_id) select cc.cc_code, cc.cc_name, actual.actual, budget.budget from finance.cost_centers cc left join actual on actual.cost_center_id = cc.cost_center_id left join budget on budget.cost_center_id = cc.cost_center_id order by cc.cc_code

tasks.name: agg_stock_movements
tasks.question: Stock movements by type between 2026-09-11 and 2026-10-10, with total quantity

queries.name: agg_stock_movements
queries.sql: select movement_type, count(*) as movements, sum(qty) as total_qty from inventory.stock_movements where moved_at >= '2026-09-11' and moved_at < '2026-10-11' group by movement_type order by movements desc

tasks.name: agg_email_ctr
tasks.question: Email click-through rate (clicks divided by delivered) per campaign, top 20

queries.name: agg_email_ctr
queries.sql: select c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, count(*) filter (where e.event_type = 'click') as clicks, count(*) filter (where e.event_type = 'delivered') as delivered, round(count(*) filter (where e.event_type = 'click')::numeric / nullif(count(*) filter (where e.event_type = 'delivered'), 0), 4) as ctr from marketing.email_events e join marketing.campaigns c on c.campaign_id = e.campaign_id group by c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name order by ctr desc nulls last, c.campaign_id limit 20

tasks.name: au_deletes_exports
tasks.question: Who deleted or exported data according to the audit log between 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-10?

queries.name: au_deletes_exports
queries.sql: select u.username, a.action, count(*) as events from public.audit_log a join ops.app_users u on u.user_id = a.actor_user_id where (a.action like 'delet%' or a.action = 'export') and a.occurred_at >= '2026-10-04' and a.occurred_at < '2026-10-11' group by u.username, a.action order by events desc, u.username, a.action limit 50

tasks.name: au_salary_changes
tasks.question: Changes to the employees salary field in the change history since 2026-07-12

queries.name: au_salary_changes
queries.sql: select change_id, record_pk, old_value, new_value, changed_by, change_source, changed_at from public.change_history where table_name = 'hr.employees' and column_name = 'salary_amt' and changed_at >= '2026-07-12' order by changed_at desc, change_id desc limit 50

tasks.name: au_failed_logins
tasks.question: Users with the most failed logins between 2026-09-11 and 2026-10-10

queries.name: au_failed_logins
queries.sql: select u.user_id, u.username, count(*) as failed from ops.login_events e join ops.app_users u on u.user_id = e.user_id where not e.success and e.event_ts >= '2026-09-11' and e.event_ts < '2026-10-11' group by u.user_id, u.username order by failed desc, u.user_id limit 20

tasks.name: au_bruteforce_ips
tasks.question: Which IP addresses had the most failed login attempts in September 2026?

queries.name: au_bruteforce_ips
queries.sql: select ip_address, count(*) as failed from ops.login_events where not success and event_ts >= '2026-09-01' and event_ts < '2026-10-01' group by ip_address order by failed desc, ip_address limit 20

tasks.name: au_subscription_cancels
tasks.question: Subscription cancellation events by cancel reason in the 12 months up to 2026-10-10

queries.name: au_subscription_cancels
queries.sql: select s.cancel_reason, count(*) as cancellations from finance.subscription_events e join finance.subscriptions s on s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id where e.event_type = 'cancel' and e.event_dt >= '2025-10-11' and e.event_dt < '2026-10-11' group by s.cancel_reason order by cancellations desc

tasks.name: au_critical_audit
tasks.question: Count of critical audit log events per action in September 2026

queries.name: au_critical_audit
queries.sql: select action, count(*) as events from public.audit_log where severity = 'critical' and occurred_at >= '2026-09-01' and occurred_at < '2026-10-01' group by action order by events desc

tasks.name: au_api_keys_failed_yesterday
tasks.question: Which API keys made the most failed requests yesterday?

queries.name: au_api_keys_failed_yesterday
queries.sql: select k.api_key_id, k.key_name, k.revoked_at, count(*) as failed from ops.api_request_log l join ops.api_keys k on k.api_key_id = l.api_key_id where l.status_code >= 400 and l.requested_at >= '2026-10-10' and l.requested_at < '2026-10-11' group by k.api_key_id, k.key_name, k.revoked_at order by failed desc, k.api_key_id limit 10

tasks.name: amb_purchase_orders_late
tasks.question: Purchase orders received later than expected, per supplier

queries.name: amb_purchase_orders_late
queries.sql: select s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, count(*) filter (where o.received_dt > o.expected_dt) as late, count(o.received_dt) as received from ops.orders o join inventory.suppliers s on s.supplier_id = o.supplier_id group by s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name order by late desc, s.supplier_id limit 50

tasks.name: amb_po_qty_warehouse
tasks.question: Total quantity ordered on purchase orders per warehouse

queries.name: amb_po_qty_warehouse
queries.sql: select w.warehouse_code, sum(ol.qty_ordered) as qty_ordered from ops.order_lines ol join ops.orders o on o.order_id = ol.order_id join inventory.warehouses w on w.warehouse_id = o.warehouse_id group by w.warehouse_code order by qty_ordered desc, w.warehouse_code

tasks.name: amb_sales_order_status
tasks.question: How many customer orders are in each status?

queries.name: amb_sales_order_status
queries.sql: select status, count(*) as orders from sales.orders group by status order by orders desc

tasks.name: amb_gl_expense_accounts
tasks.question: List the expense accounts in the chart of accounts

queries.name: amb_gl_expense_accounts
queries.sql: select gl_account_id, account_code, account_name from finance.chart_of_accounts where account_type = 'expense' order by account_code

tasks.name: amb_support_tier
tasks.question: How many client accounts are on each support tier?

queries.name: amb_support_tier
queries.sql: select t.tier_name, count(*) as accounts from crm.accounts a join support.tiers t on t.tier_id = a.support_tier_id group by t.tier_name order by accounts desc

tasks.name: amb_login_account_types
tasks.question: How many login accounts of each user type are there?

queries.name: amb_login_account_types
queries.sql: select user_type, count(*) as users from ops.app_users group by user_type order by users desc

tasks.name: amb_order_shipments
tasks.question: Average days from sales order date to delivery for orders placed in 2026

queries.name: amb_order_shipments
queries.sql: select round(avg(extract(epoch from (s.delivered_at - o.order_dt)) / 86400)::numeric, 2) as avg_days from ops.shipments s join sales.orders o on o.order_id = s.sales_order_id where o.order_dt >= '2026-01-01' and o.order_dt < '2027-01-01' and s.delivered_at is not null

tasks.name: lg_legacy_country
tasks.question: How many customers per country are in the legacy CRM dump?

queries.name: lg_legacy_country
queries.sql: select cntry, count(*) as customers from public.tbl_cust_legacy group by cntry order by customers desc, cntry limit 50

tasks.name: lg_archive_2019_region
tasks.question: Total net revenue in the 2019 order archive per region

queries.name: lg_archive_2019_region
queries.sql: select region_txt, sum(net) as net_revenue from sales.orders_archive_2019 group by region_txt order by net_revenue desc

tasks.name: lg_newsletter_country
tasks.question: How many active newsletter subscribers are there per country?

queries.name: lg_newsletter_country
queries.sql: select country, count(*) as subscribers from marketing.newsletter_subscribers where unsubscribed_at is null group by country order by subscribers desc, country limit 30

tasks.name: lg_app_settings
tasks.question: Show the application settings

queries.name: lg_app_settings
queries.sql: select setting_key, setting_value, updated_at from public.app_settings order by setting_key

tasks.name: lg_archive_customer
tasks.question: Top 10 customers by gross revenue in the 2019 order archive, with their current customer name

queries.name: lg_archive_customer
queries.sql: select c.cust_id, c.customer_name, sum(ar.gross) as gross from sales.orders_archive_2019 ar join sales.customers c on c.customer_code = ar.cust_ref group by c.cust_id, c.customer_name order by gross desc, c.cust_id limit 10

tasks.name: lg_change_history_ui
tasks.question: Which employees made the most changes through the UI according to the change history?

queries.name: lg_change_history_ui
queries.sql: select e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, count(*) as changes from public.change_history ch join hr.employees e on e.employee_id = ch.changed_by where ch.change_source = 'ui' group by e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name order by changes desc, e.employee_id limit 10

tasks.name: lg_legacy_migrated
tasks.question: How many legacy CRM customers were migrated to a current customer record?

queries.name: lg_legacy_migrated
queries.sql: select count(*) filter (where migrated_to_cust_id is not null) as migrated, count(*) as total from public.tbl_cust_legacy

tasks.name: wd_employees_hires_2026
tasks.question: Employees hired in 2026 with their job title and department name

queries.name: wd_employees_hires_2026
queries.sql: select e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.job_title, d.dept_name, e.hire_dt from hr.employees e join hr.departments d on d.department_id = e.department_id where e.hire_dt >= '2026-01-01' and e.hire_dt < '2027-01-01' order by e.hire_dt, e.employee_id limit 200

tasks.name: wd_accounts_strategic
tasks.question: Strategic tier accounts with their industry and annual revenue, largest first

queries.name: wd_accounts_strategic
queries.sql: select account_id, account_name, industry, annual_revenue_amt from crm.accounts where tier = 'strategic' order by annual_revenue_amt desc, account_id limit 50

tasks.name: wd_products_margin
tasks.question: Which products have the highest margin between list price and unit cost?

queries.name: wd_products_margin
queries.sql: select product_id, sku, product_name, list_price, unit_cost, list_price - unit_cost as margin from inventory.products order by margin desc, product_id limit 20

tasks.name: wd_orders_channel_q3
tasks.question: Order count and USD total by sales channel in 2026-Q3

queries.name: wd_orders_channel_q3
queries.sql: select channel, count(*) as orders, sum(total_usd) as total_usd from sales.orders where order_dt >= '2026-07-01' and order_dt < '2026-10-01' group by channel order by total_usd desc

tasks.name: wd_manager_other_dept
tasks.question: How many employees have a manager in a different department?

queries.name: wd_manager_other_dept
queries.sql: select count(*) as employees from hr.employees e join hr.employees m on m.employee_id = e.manager_id where m.department_id <> e.department_id

tasks.name: wd_terminations_year
tasks.question: How many employees were terminated each year?

queries.name: wd_terminations_year
queries.sql: select extract(year from term_dt)::int as year, count(*) as terminated from hr.employees where term_dt is not null group by 1 order by 1

tasks.name: wd_hazmat_products
tasks.question: List active hazardous products with their weight and country of origin

queries.name: wd_hazmat_products
queries.sql: select product_id, sku, product_name, weight_kg, country_of_origin from inventory.products where is_hazmat and is_active order by product_id limit 100

tasks.name: vg_best_customers
tasks.question: Who are our best customers?

queries.name: vg_best_customers
queries.sql: select c.cust_id, c.customer_name, sum(o.total_usd) as revenue_usd from sales.orders o join sales.customers c on c.cust_id = o.cust_id where o.status not in ('cancelled', 'draft') group by c.cust_id, c.customer_name order by revenue_usd desc, c.cust_id limit 10

tasks.name: vg_whats_low_stock
tasks.question: What are we running low on?

queries.name: vg_whats_low_stock
queries.sql: select p.sku, p.product_name, w.warehouse_code, s.qty_on_hand - s.qty_reserved as available, s.reorder_point from inventory.stock_levels s join inventory.products p on p.product_id = s.product_id join inventory.warehouses w on w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id where s.qty_on_hand - s.qty_reserved < s.reorder_point order by s.reorder_point - (s.qty_on_hand - s.qty_reserved) desc, s.warehouse_id, s.product_id limit 50

tasks.name: vg_complaints
tasks.question: Which clients are complaining the most?

queries.name: vg_complaints
queries.sql: select a.account_id, a.account_name, count(*) as tickets from support.tickets t join crm.accounts a on a.account_id = t.account_id group by a.account_id, a.account_name order by tickets desc, a.account_id limit 10

tasks.name: vg_sales_trend
tasks.question: How are sales trending this year?

queries.name: vg_sales_trend
queries.sql: select date_trunc('month', order_dt)::date as month, count(*) as orders, sum(total_usd) as revenue_usd from sales.orders where order_dt >= '2026-01-01' and order_dt < '2026-10-11' and status not in ('cancelled', 'draft') group by 1 order by 1

tasks.name: vg_who_owes
tasks.question: Who owes us money?

queries.name: vg_who_owes
queries.sql: select c.cust_id, c.customer_name, sum(i.total_amt) as outstanding from finance.invoices i join sales.customers c on c.cust_id = i.cust_id where i.status in ('open', 'overdue') group by c.cust_id, c.customer_name order by outstanding desc, c.cust_id limit 20

tasks.name: vg_churn
tasks.question: Why are customers leaving?

queries.name: vg_churn
queries.sql: select cancel_reason, count(*) as cancelled from finance.subscriptions where status = 'cancelled' group by cancel_reason order by cancelled desc

tasks.name: vg_top_sellers
tasks.question: Who are our top sellers?

queries.name: vg_top_sellers
queries.sql: select e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, sum(o.total_usd) as revenue_usd from sales.orders o join hr.employees e on e.employee_id = o.sales_rep_id where o.status not in ('cancelled', 'draft') group by e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name order by revenue_usd desc, e.employee_id limit 10
